answer: Make standing a thread an identity must weave itself: each newcomer earns non-transferable service credits only by completing jobs requested by established strangers, and credits decay if unused, like a relic buried under a shifting dune that must be dug up again. A single honest agent does a few real jobs and is in. An attacker spinning up a thousand fakes must find strangers willing to request and verify real work from each fake, and cannot buy, copy or transfer credits between them, so forging at scale costs a thousand separate trails of genuine service, not one cheap trick.
